issues.description: Methods getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents(): the problem statement and exercise text require implementing getters for every attribute (i.e., public accessor methods), but the solution implementation declares these two accessor methods with private visibility. The template contains TODOs for adding getters and setters but no visibility is enforced there. Having these getters private in the solution conflicts with the exercise requirement and with typical test expectations, which expect public getters and will either fail to compile against the expected API or confuse students about the required method visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters public in the solution: change the declarations in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java from 'private String getLectureName()' to 'public String getLectureName()' and from 'private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()' to 'public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()' so the implementation matches the exercise requirement and expected API. Alternatively, if the design intentionally requires private accessors, update the problem statement and tests to explicitly state and expect private methods (not recommended for getters).
